features.title: Claude in Echo is told what the plugin gives: installed, its part is laid out in the data folder's .plugins/obsidian/ (finding a vault, asking Echo's index with the CLI there, adding notes, where the user manages it) and the core lists it with the manifest's summary

Each confirmed vault is an entry for Claude: a row in the core with its "when Claude looks here" line, a guide in .plugins/obsidian/<vault>/ with its name, folder and the path of its description to Read as data; the summary names the vaults; a vault not yet confirmed has none
A vault's change reaches Claude at once: its "when" line or name edited, or the vault removed (its entry gone)

A vault's description is the user's data to Claude: a hostile "when" line (a |, tags, a line break, an instruction) stays one escaped row of the core, and no words of the user's description go into the guide, which points to the description as data
No runtime skill: the skill older versions gave (obsidian-vaults) is taken away and none is laid out

Claude in Echo may run the index's commands without asking (uses.sessions.commands: search, info, links, backlinks, resolve, tags, where, tasks, unresolved, rename_plan — named on the install sheet); they work from the laid-out launcher and only read

Updated from Obsidian vaults 0.8: the update asks again (it may now change the folders), the vaults keep their ids, descriptions, for whom and Claude's entries, each takes a call's minutes only when asked; 0.8's facts vault, its pipeline's state, its entry for Claude and its commands are gone at once, and a second load changes nothing
A vault's settings (minutes auto/ask/off, AI profile, commit, ingest, its folders) are checked as the user sets them; one vault is the default for minutes, and removing it leaves none
A folder that is a vault already, is inside one, or holds one isn't connected again, and the folder is given back

Echo finds a vault's shape without changing it — its pages folder, index, notes folder and naming, templates, sources, taxonomies, rules, skills, Obsidian's settings — when it is connected, when asked to read it again (the user's overrides kept), and once in the background for a vault from 0.8

One index per vault over its pages folder (sources, templates and machinery left out), rebuilt by size and time, with a revision; Claude's index commands keep their arguments and answers, their note paths relative to the pages folder, named as `pages` when it isn't the vault's root

A page reads as safe HTML: links to the vault's pages route inside Echo, a missing page is marked, https and Echo's links kept, images only png/jpg/gif/webp from inside the vault, the vault's own markup (scripts, javascript: and file: links, raw HTML, code) stays text; with its links, backlinks and their lines, local graph, and whether the index lists it

An edit is saved only over the text it was opened with: a change made meanwhile comes back as a conflict with what is there now and is never written over; line endings are kept; a page that isn't UTF-8 or is over 2 MB is read only

A new page from the vault's template (title, date, time filled) or its page format, named in the folder's own way, never over a page that is there, with a row in the index's table for its folder when asked

In a vault in git: a save, a new page and a restore commit only the files Echo wrote when the vault's commit is on; a page's history, a version's text and changes; a restore never over changes git hasn't got nor over a change made while git was asked, never of a version too large or not UTF-8, and is a new commit
Find pages in a vault: by #tag, then by title, path and words in the text, each text hit with its line as plain text
The vault's graph: pages with their top folder, tags and number of links, links as edges, tags as nodes when asked, the index a hub; the 0.8 browser still draws it
A vault's checks, read only: pages the index doesn't list, broken links, isolated pages, pages without properties, tags the taxonomy doesn't allow, index rows to missing pages
Every change Echo makes in a vault leaves a line in its activity log (what, by whom, lines added and removed, the commit, the version restored, the index row written with it), the last 2,000 kept
Paths never leave the vault: no `..`, absolute path, drive, device name or link, and never a dot folder (.git, .obsidian), the sources or the templates as a page — read or written

A page is read, written, asked of git and committed by its real name: typed in another case, or reached through a folder linked inside the vault, it is that file — Echo's commit never takes the user's uncommitted edits along and restore's guard holds

A vault from 0.8 keeps 0.8's index — its whole folder, sources and templates included — until the user confirms the shape Echo found (or sets one of its folders); a vault connected in 1.0 uses the shape at once

Links and tags are read as Obsidian (and 0.8) reads them, by one reader for Claude's commands, pages, the graph and the checks: none inside %%…%%, <!-- -->, $$…$$ or any code span; a heading's links and #tags count; tags from tags: or tag:, split at commas and spaces; no tag after ( ; no Markdown link with a space in its bare address

Knowledge is the plugin's own activity (a folder of notes icon in the activity bar, full screen): #17's header, vault switcher, ⋯ menu and tabs Home · Pages · Graph · Ingest · Health · Settings (no Ask), its own routes #obsidian:knowledge/<vault>/<tab>/<path> (a vault opens on Home, the last one again), its badge the changes waiting and the findings that need the user

A page reads as #17 read it: the tree with its filters and find, the page's properties and Echo's safe HTML, its links routing inside the activity, a missing page offered to make, web links opened by Echo, the Links, Outline and History rails and the local graph

A page is edited as #17 did: the editor with its live preview, typed text kept across Echo's redraws, a save only over what was opened (committed when the vault commits), a change on disk shown as the conflict with Compare, Take theirs and Keep mine; a new page; a page's row put in the index
A page's history in the activity: its versions from git, a version's diff, Restore — refused over changes git hasn't got, else a new commit
The Graph tab draws #17's live graph: by folder or tag with its legend, find, a page selected with its card and its local graph, the index and isolated pages hidden or shown, tags as nodes
The Health tab lists the code checks' findings by group and kind with #17's score, trend (one point a day) and filters; a finding with its pages, Ask about it and Ignore / List again
Home: what changed in the last 14 days (Echo's writes and git's commits), the Health card, where to start reading, the vault's card and the Ask card

A vault's Settings tab keeps 0.8's What Claude knows (its state, the When-line and the five parts changed in place, read again, confirm, a new reading proposed) and For whom (clients and threads), then #17's Structure, Meeting minutes, Ingest, Ask, Schema, Skills and Git & AI; a setting changed is kept; Remove asks first
Ask the vault opens Claude Code in Echo's panel, in its own tab Claude · Knowledge, in the vault (its pages folder the project), on the user's click only; nothing is typed into it

A call's page shows Knowledge in Echo's generic slots: the chip (call.header) says where its minutes go by themselves (the thread's vault, else the client's, else the default; automatic; the call's AI profile) and its menu chooses one or none; the ⋯ menu's Save to Knowledge… opens the save sheet over the call (call.menu, ctx.ui.sheet); the line while the minutes come (call.minutes)
Echo's Settings → From plugins → Knowledge lists the vaults and opens each in the activity; ⌘K has Knowledge's actions

What later versions bring says so where #17 showed it, never made up: Ingest and its sources, Health's fixes and AI checks, minutes saved into a vault, a new vault from the twin starter, the twin skill
